title: AR Caller-Trainee
description: Job Title : AR Caller Trainee (US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management) Location :Hyderabad, Telangana (Work from Office) Shift Timing : US Night Shift (Monday to Friday, Fixed Weekends Off) Experience:** 0–1 Year (Freshers with strong communication skills welcome) Role Overview : As an **AR Caller Trainee**, you will undergo structured classroom and on-the-job training in US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Following training, you will be responsible for contacting US health insurance payers on behalf of healthcare providers to verify claim statuses, investigate unpaid or denied medical claims, and ensure timely reimbursement while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance. Key Responsibilities : Training & Process Mastery : Complete intensive training on US Healthcare RCM fundamentals, HIPAA guidelines, insurance terminologies (EOB, deductible, copay, coinsurance), and basic CPT/ICD-10 coding concepts. Claim Follow-Up : Review assigned unpaid or aging claims and initiate outbound calls or check payer portals to determine accurate claim statuses. Denial & Underpayment Resolution : Identify root causes for claim rejections, denials, or underpayments, gather necessary documentation, and coordinate with internal medical billing and coding teams for timely re-submission or appeals. Accurate Documentation : Record detailed call notes, payer responses, claim reference numbers, and next-step action items in the billing/practice management software after every interaction. Target & Quality Adherence : Meet daily call volume, productivity, and quality audit benchmarks as defined by process SLAs. Compliance : Adhere strictly to HIPAA regulations and data security protocols to safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI). Qualifications & Skills : Education : Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Life Sciences, Pharmacy, B.Com, BBA, or B.Sc graduates preferred; 10+2 / Diploma holders with exceptional communication may also be considered). Communication : Fluent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation, active listening, and neutral accent comprehension. Analytical & Problem-Solving : Strong logical reasoning to analyze Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and resolve claim discrepancies. Technical Proficiency : Basic working knowledge of MS Office (especially MS Excel) and good typing speed (minimum 25–30 WPM with high accuracy). Shift Flexibility : Willingness to work permanently in US night shifts from the office. Pay: ₹120,000.00 - ₹180,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

title: GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee)
description: Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Shift Operator) We are looking for Graduate Engineer Trainees (Shift Operators) . Freshers are welcome to apply. This role provides an opportunity to develop hands-on technical expertise in water treatment plant operations, maintenance, documentation, and operator competency. Key Responsibilities Ensure adherence to industrial safety practices during all plant operations and maintenance activities. Operate and monitor pre-treatment, water generation, storage, and distribution systems as per prescribed SOPs. Ensure optimal and safe operation of all plant equipment. Monitor utility and feed-water parameters and ensure compliance with specified operating limits. Prepare and maintain operational records, including log sheets, chemical consumption records, preventive maintenance (PM) records, and other required documentation. Verify sensor calibration using appropriate test kits and maintain relevant records. Coordinate with the QC team for water sampling and analysis. Perform basic/non-critical maintenance activities, such as attending to minor leakages, using available tools. Record operational issues, observations, and corrective actions in accordance with QA documentation procedures. Participate in classroom and hands-on technical training conducted by CN and customers to develop and maintain competency in plant operations. Assist in conducting periodic hands-on training for operators and support competency assessment and certification. Follow assigned shift schedules and support contingency arrangements at the site. Perform assigned site administrative activities, including HR compliance, documentation, invoicing, payment follow-up, and other related responsibilities. Follow all applicable SOPs, safety procedures, quality requirements, and customer/site guidelines. Eligibility Diploma in Engineering – Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Instrumentation / relevant discipline. Freshers are welcome to apply. Candidates with experience in DM / RO / Purified Water Systems / Utility Operations & Maintenance will also be considered. Willingness to work in shift operations and site environments. Good learning attitude, discipline, and willingness to develop technical and operational skills. How to Apply Interested candidates can directly share their CV: Email: isha.lad@cnwater.in Call / WhatsApp: 84509 64162 Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹19,000.00 per month Benefits: Food provided Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Article Assistant
description: Company Description GMRR & Co. is a professional services firm that provides quality solutions across audit, investigation, due diligence, accounting, and taxation for domestic and foreign companies. The firm also offers expertise in company law matters, management consultancy, fixed assets verification, and FEMA-related services. Its multidisciplinary approach supports clients in meeting regulatory requirements while improving financial and operational efficiency. Team members gain exposure to a wide range of industries and complex assignments, creating strong opportunities for professional growth and learning. Role Description The Article Assistant will support the firm’s audit, accounting, taxation, and compliance engagements under the guidance of senior team members. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting in statutory and internal audits, preparing working papers and documentation, performing basic accounting and reconciliations, and supporting tax return preparation and filings. The role also involves conducting research on relevant laws and regulations, compiling reports, maintaining client files, and helping with due diligence and verification assignments as needed. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, requiring regular coordination with supervisors and clients to meet project timelines and quality standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong accounting and bookkeeping skills, including familiarity with ledgers, reconciliations, and financial statements. Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of audit procedures, documentation standards, and basic internal control concepts. Candidates should possess an understanding of direct and indirect taxation, company law fundamentals, and regulatory compliance requirements. Candidates should possess good analytical and research abilities, with capacity to interpret financial data and relevant laws or guidelines. Candidates should possess clear written and verbal communication skills, along with attention to detail and organized work habits. Enrollment in or completion of professional qualifications such as CA (Article-ship stage), or a degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance is preferred. Ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment in Hyderabad, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines is essential. Proficiency with office productivity tools and basic accounting software will be an added advantage.

title: B2B Marketing Intern
description: B2B Marketing Intern Company: VRT Management Group, LLC Location: Santosh Nagar, Hyderabad (Onsite) Type: Full-time About VRT Management Group, LLC VRT Management Group, LLC is a management consulting company founded in 2008 in the USA. Our mission is to empower small and medium-scale business leaders across the United States through high-impact services such as VEGA – Visionary Entrepreneurs Growth Accelerator. With our growing Hyderabad operations, we are building a high-performing marketing team to scale our impact and strengthen our lead generation engine. Role Overview As a B2B Marketer Intern , you will play a key role in building and executing VRT’s B2B content and lead generation strategy. This is a hands-on role focused on creating high-converting marketing content, supporting campaigns across LinkedIn, email, webinars, partnerships, and digital channels, and driving measurable business outcomes such as Leads → Calls Booked → Showups . You will work closely with the CEO and internal stakeholders to translate business insights, stories, and offers into compelling content assets that attract, engage, and convert USA SMB entrepreneurs. Key Responsibilities Own and support monthly pipeline targets across the funnel: Leads → Calls Booked → Showups . Plan and execute B2B lead generation campaigns across LinkedIn, email, webinars, partnerships, and other digital channels. Create, refine, and optimize content for lead generation and nurturing, including: LinkedIn posts, Email sequences, Newsletters, Website and landing page copy , Blogs and short-form articles Interview and gather content inputs from Rajesh Tedla (CEO) and internal stakeholders to extract insights, offers, and stories for campaigns. Convert raw ideas and inputs into polished, audience-focused marketing assets. Maintain consistency in VRT/EGA brand voice, messaging, and positioning. Publish and schedule content using approved marketing tools and maintain a structured content calendar. Track weekly funnel metrics and campaign performance to identify opportunities for improving conversion rates. Work with designers, editors, and other team members by preparing clear creative briefs and coordinating execution. Support performance marketing initiatives across LinkedIn and email; exposure to Meta, YouTube, and Instagram campaigns is a plus. Continuously test, learn, and improve messaging, content formats, and distribution strategies based on results. Required Skills / What We’re Looking For 0–1 years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, lead generation, or growth marketing. Strong understanding of LinkedIn and email marketing fundamentals. Ability to create persuasive and audience-relevant marketing copy. Good understanding of funnel metrics such as leads, booked calls, show rate, and conversions. Strong communication and execution skills with a high sense of ownership.
